definitions.hypotenuse: The side opposite the right angle and longest side of a right triangle.
definitions.leg: One of two sides forming the right angle.
definitions.sine: For an acute right-triangle angle, opposite leg divided by hypotenuse.
definitions.cosine: For an acute right-triangle angle, adjacent leg divided by hypotenuse.
definitions.tangent: For an acute right-triangle angle, opposite leg divided by adjacent leg.
definitions.inverse trigonometry: Finding an angle from a trigonometric ratio using an inverse trigonometric function.
definitions.elevation: An angle measured upward from horizontal sight.
definitions.depression: An angle measured downward from horizontal sight.
definitions.bearing: A direction expressed as an angle relative to a stated compass reference.
definitions.vector: A quantity with magnitude and direction, often drawn as an arrow.
